correctness.rationale: The conic symmetric matrix has determinant 256, so smooth for primes >=5. Exact 35 line-triple determinants have only 2,3,5 prime factors (five zeros); seven line-section discriminants are nonzero squares 256,1024,9216 with prime supports 2,3; exact 66 cross-product-coordinate gcds among the 12 rational characteristic-zero incidence points have no primes >=7. Thus for all p>=7 no labeled line collisions, new concurrence, nontransverse conic contacts or distinct point collisions; pair count 21+14=35 yields (n2,n3,n4)=(5,4,3). At p=5 line pairs l3~l5,l4~l6 collide, and complete F5 projective-plane/Bezout pair count gives six ordinary points (2,2,2) on reduced support. Independent arithmetic check confirmed invertible M with det -7 (mod5=3), MᵀB10M=diag(1,1,-1) mod5 and all five pullback line covectors equal CL4 up to scalars. The nonreduced original product is explicitly not covered by geometric support claims.
